name: Acsa (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Acsa (a blue shield with a white lamb and a sun) within a green wreath, above a yellow scroll inscribed ACSA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Acsa arms with wreath and scroll
